item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 16/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft now covering the coast of Guangdong will weaken tomorrow, and there will be more showers over the region. A tough of low pressure is expected to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China in the following couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening again early to midweek next week, it will be brighter and hot over the coast of southern China. Meanwhile, a southerly airstream will bring showers to the region.
